answer: A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The sonnet counter is kept in atlas and violet exposes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 606 identities would post 1523 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
